title: LLD Practice Library
description: A separate problem bank for guided design, independent design, machine coding and evolving-requirement challenges.

practiceModes.title: Guided design
practiceModes.description: Work through requirements, object discovery, relationships and design decisions with progressive hints.

practiceModes.title: Independent design
practiceModes.description: Produce a design without hints, then compare it with a reference design and trade-offs.

practiceModes.title: Machine coding
practiceModes.description: Build a runnable Java implementation with tests and a clear project structure.

practiceModes.title: Change request challenge
practiceModes.description: Evolve the design after new requirements are introduced and assess the cost of change.
